title: NYSE Parent ICE Raises $3.75 Billion for MarketAxess Takeover
summary: Intercontinental Exchange Inc. sold $3.75 billion of US investment-grade bonds on Tuesday, less than two weeks after announcing a $6 billion deal to acquire MarketAxess Holdings Inc.

title: Phoebe Gates Knew Phia App Took Credit For Sales It Didn’t Drive
summary: Phia co-founders Phoebe Gates and Sophia Kianni pushed for features in the startup’s software that took credit for sales it didn’t drive. The founders were aware of the practice for at least seven months. Olivia Solon reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
